response.overview: Elsa's mother is in labour, but in such an isolated island village, the arrival of a baby can only be faced with ingenuity and courage. This is what Mensi, Elsa's grandmother, does, trying to keep the girl from realising the seriousness of the situation. However, Elsa will find a way to witness the great event from her own unique perspective.
response.title: The White Daughters  (Las hijas blancas)
